limitations: Hashes record repository bytes inspected during packaging; hosted code is not included or executed.
Installed validation checks local client bytes and this retained review declaration.
Hosted deployment, live controls and model delivery require separate acceptance evidence.

external_boundaries.content: Generic act identifiers, Patent Box topics and period terms; the workflow instructs the host not to send client facts or identifiers in queries
controls: Host public research uses generic legal terms and act identifiers without client facts. The source adapter makes read-only HTTPS requests only within the model-reviewed public plan and rechecks each redirect and DNS address; credentials, cookies and proxy settings are not sent. It retains original bytes and extracted-text hashes, records failed or partial coverage and leaves applicability for professional review. Proposal confirmations require a complete declared scan whose selected original bytes match the proposed rule sources and are at most 24 hours old. Private case indexes and impact queues remain local. No scheduler or external notification is enabled; bundled real rules remain DRAFT.
external_boundaries.destination: Official tax and legal sources selected by the host model
external_boundaries.purpose: Acquire current and period-specific source material for professional review

external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.
external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow

classes.content: The host model may read the selected client identity and period; software, patent, design and rights evidence; technical descriptions, contracts and supplier chains; ledger cells and literal PDF page passages; personnel/payroll rows, activity and project allocations; reviewed exchange-rate evidence, credit notes, exclusions and suspected duplicates; prior options and incentives; public source text and proposed control rationales with citations. Relevant selected documents can be read in full. Local snapshots and CSV/XLSX/PDF parsing do not anonymize them or prevent host-model processing. Runtime profiles describe account boundaries; current development checks do not establish installed Codex or Cowork acceptance.
classes.purpose: Extract case facts and propose detailed controls and draft A/B text

classes.content: Readable proposals and Word/PDF drafts expose normalized costs and original component rows, fiscal bases, mappings, rate provenance, control totals, duplicate decisions, located facts, rights/activity/supplier records, missing-document requests, source-specific incentive formulas, annual return mappings, adversarial questions, control statuses, evidence/source citations, rules and A/B narratives. Preparation may contain real case data. Proposal confirmation retains the user actor, actual confirmation reference, time and hashes of this exact proposal, evidence, sources and outputs. No professional role, certificate, signature or firm mandate is required. Optional inspection of separately selected signed documents may expose certificate subjects, issuers and verification results; it is not a condition for calculation or proposal approval. Real rules remain unapproved by default. Technical tests do not establish professional or installed-runtime acceptance. Reopening adds the stated reason, references and hashes of selected prior approvals; a successor run reads only explicitly selected archive upstream artifacts. A configured host monitor may read its owner, selected local paths, public plan, private opaque case index, prior approval hashes and local notice records. Its persistent native task prompt contains the chosen paths and public scope; current host/account storage and model-context boundaries apply.
classes.purpose: Review exact proposals, identify missing documents and explain draft calculations

classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested

classes.content: An exactly confirmed owner/tenant/client/engagement/run/public-output mandate retains the literal question, propose/normalize_ledger task, original IDs and chosen complete output-record names. The explicit context returns the complete session input/evidence register except selected_path, selected original names/hashes/byte counts, every chosen complete JSON record, all public schemas, control catalogue, full specialist skill and proposed real DRAFT rules. The separate explicit original-source tool returns only selected IDs: complete UTF-8 text for txt/csv/md/json/xml up to 1000000 source bytes, or exact path/hash/byte count and a binary-reader instruction without binary content. Larger text requires ordinary whole-file specialist reading; no truncated text substitutes. Complete context/source results and private complete proposal/readback/preflight envelopes refuse over 2000000 UTF-8 serialized bytes without sampling. Actual host binary/original reading, semantic extraction and provider telemetry remain unverified; a durable service read packet is not proof all originals were read. The model stages one entire proposal/normalization plan with actual declared runtime/provider/model/template/session provenance and receives only a stage-reference acknowledgement. Whole private body/preview, literal unsent questions, typed producer fields and review/signature choices stay app-only when the installed host honors visibility. Adoption, renewed public execution, local assertion, real certificate/firm-mandate review, final signed approval, formalities and Archive completion remain separate. No automatic anonymization, local-only guarantee, model API client, automatic real-rule approval, signer impersonation or client-folder discovery is supplied.
classes.purpose: Prepare a complete Patent Box proposal or normalization plan from explicitly granted registered evidence using the current host model

de: Das Sitzungsmodell kann ausgewählte Dokumente vollständig lesen: relevante Identitäten, Rechte, Verträge, Tätigkeiten, Personen, Buchungszeilen, Quellen, Begründungen und Dossiertexte. Es kann Zertifikate, berufliche Namen und Referenzen, Mandate und Prüfergebnisse lesen. Codex verwendet das OpenAI-Sitzungsmodell, Cowork das Anthropic-Sitzungsmodell zu den jeweiligen Kontobedingungen. Lokale Verarbeitung, Kopien, Hashwerte und Exporte anonymisieren Daten nicht und garantieren keine ausschließlich lokale Verarbeitung.

Öffentliche Recherche verwendet allgemeine Abfragen ohne Mandantendaten. Die lokale Kryptoprüfung sendet keine Netzwerkanfragen. Wählt die Fachperson einen externen Signaturdienst, überträgt sie selbst den Antrag mit opaken Kennungen, Zeitraum, Erklärung und Hashwerten oder das Mandat; das Plugin lädt nichts hoch und fordert keine privaten Schlüssel an.

Eine im Host konfigurierte Überwachung kann ausgewählte Pfade, Verantwortliche, den öffentlichen Rechercheumfang sowie private Fall- und Freigabeverweise dem Modell und dem Aufgabenspeicher zugänglich machen. Diese Verweise werden nicht in öffentlichen Suchen gesendet. Der Fallbericht trennt messbare von nicht messbaren Nachweisen; er verspricht keine vollständige Zählung der beim Anbieter eingegangenen Daten.
en: The session model may read selected documents in full: relevant identities, rights, contracts, activities, people, accounting rows, sources, rationales and dossier text. It may read certificates, professional names and references, mandates and verification results. Codex uses the OpenAI session model; Cowork uses the Anthropic session model, under the respective account terms. Local parsing, copies, hashes and exports neither anonymize data nor guarantee local-only processing.

Public research uses generic queries without client data. Local cryptographic verification makes no network requests. If the professional chooses an external signing service, they personally transfer the request containing opaque identifiers, period, statement and hashes, or the mandate; the plugin does not upload it or request private keys.

A host-configured monitor may expose selected paths, its owner, public scope and private case and approval references to the model and task storage. These references are not sent in public searches. The case report distinguishes measurable from unmeasurable evidence; it does not promise a complete count of the data received by the provider.
es: El modelo de la sesión puede leer los documentos seleccionados completos: identidades pertinentes, derechos, contratos, actividades, personas, filas contables, fuentes, motivos y textos del expediente. Puede leer certificados, nombres y referencias profesionales, mandatos y resultados de verificación. Codex usa el modelo de sesión de OpenAI; Cowork, el de Anthropic, según las condiciones de la cuenta respectiva. El tratamiento, las copias, huellas y exportaciones locales no anonimizan los datos ni garantizan un tratamiento exclusivamente local.

La investigación pública utiliza consultas genéricas sin datos del cliente. La verificación criptográfica local no hace solicitudes de red. Si el profesional elige un servicio de firma externo, transfiere personalmente la solicitud con identificadores opacos, periodo, declaración y huellas, o el mandato; el plugin no la carga ni solicita claves privadas.

Un seguimiento configurado en el entorno anfitrión puede exponer al modelo y al almacenamiento de la tarea las rutas elegidas, el responsable, el alcance público y las referencias privadas a expedientes y aprobaciones. Estas referencias no se envían en búsquedas públicas. El informe distingue pruebas medibles de las no medibles; no promete un recuento completo de los datos recibidos por el proveedor.
fr: Le modèle de session peut lire les documents sélectionnés en entier : identités pertinentes, droits, contrats, activités, personnes, lignes comptables, sources, motifs et textes du dossier. Il peut lire certificats, noms et références professionnels, mandats et résultats de vérification. Codex utilise le modèle de session OpenAI ; Cowork, celui d’Anthropic, selon les conditions du compte concerné. Traitement, copies, empreintes et exports locaux n’anonymisent pas les données et ne garantissent pas un traitement uniquement local.

La recherche publique utilise des requêtes génériques sans données client. La vérification cryptographique locale ne fait aucune requête réseau. Si le professionnel choisit un service de signature externe, il y transfère lui-même la demande contenant identifiants opaques, période, déclaration et empreintes, ou le mandat ; le plugin ne la téléverse pas et ne demande pas de clés privées.

Une veille configurée dans l’hôte peut exposer au modèle et au stockage de la tâche les chemins sélectionnés, le responsable, le périmètre public et les références privées aux dossiers et approbations. Ces références ne sont pas envoyées dans les recherches publiques. Le rapport distingue les preuves mesurables des non mesurables ; il ne promet pas un décompte complet des données reçues par le fournisseur.
it: Il modello della sessione può leggere anche per intero i documenti selezionati: identità pertinenti, diritti, contratti, attività, persone, righe contabili, fonti, motivazioni e testi del fascicolo. Può leggere certificati, nomi e riferimenti professionali, mandati e risultati di verifica. Codex usa il modello della sessione OpenAI; Cowork quello della sessione Anthropic, alle condizioni del rispettivo account. Parsing, copie, impronte ed esportazioni locali non anonimizzano i dati e non garantiscono un trattamento soltanto locale.

La ricerca pubblica usa quesiti generici senza dati del cliente. La verifica crittografica locale non effettua richieste di rete. Se il professionista sceglie un servizio di firma esterno, vi trasferisce personalmente la richiesta con identificativi opachi, periodo, dichiarazione e impronte, oppure il mandato; il plugin non la carica e non richiede chiavi private.

Un monitor configurato nell’host può esporre al modello e alla memoria dell’attività i percorsi selezionati, il responsabile, il perimetro pubblico e i riferimenti privati alle pratiche e alle approvazioni. Non invia questi riferimenti nelle ricerche pubbliche. Il report della pratica distingue quanto è misurabile da quanto non è misurabile: non promette un conteggio completo dei dati ricevuti dal provider.

security_controls.control: All workflow actions load the actual Studio Archive v2 context for patent-box-review, require a running run, constrain writes to its output directory and snapshot only its exact selected receipts.

Selected source and snapshot hashes are rechecked before every action; proposals, explicit decisions and results are created exclusively at distinct digest-bound paths. Missing or stale decisions cannot calculate. Hashes do not authenticate a professional reviewer.

Closed schemas, exact evidence/source references, detailed child-control aggregation, duplicate ledger-row detection, allocation limits and Decimal arithmetic reject malformed or unsupported data rather than inferring an outcome.

Real calculation requires a current dated archive run, reviewed rules, current source/evidence bindings and the user’s explicit confirmation of the exact proposal. No professional role, certificate, signature or mandate is required. Missing or changed source evidence still blocks calculation.
Generated CSV cells that begin with spreadsheet formula prefixes are escaped before export.

Selected CSV/XLSX/PDF table proposals are replayed from the bound original bytes; normalization checks closed row populations, reviewed source totals and Decimal calculations. Unresolved duplicate groups stay attached to affected costs and cannot receive a PASS cost control. Source meaning, fiscal eligibility and completeness of selected ranges require professional review.

The configured OpenSSL 3 executable receives fixed argument arrays without a shell, private temporary files and a restricted environment. Files and selected evidence are bounded; no certificate/CRL/OCSP/AIA network retrieval occurs. CMS content and PDF byte ranges are checked against exact bytes; an earlier PDF signature cannot establish acceptance of unsigned later content.

The request binds client, engagement, period, run, evidence, proposal, rules and source preflight. The retained user decision records actor, actual confirmation reference and time without claiming authenticated professional identity. Final approval additionally binds every exact dossier artifact. Missing confirmation or changed bytes cannot inherit approval.

Changed approved work requires the user’s confirmation of the specific reopening proposal and its reason, preserving hash references to the previous version. No fresh signature, role or mandate is required; archive scope and upstream isolation remain enforced.

The local coordinator starts disabled. Native scheduling requires an explicit user request and the actual host tool receipt; the local reference is labelled as an operator attestation. Every scan outcome persists, including unchanged and failed work; partial scans cannot replace complete baselines. Private indexes and queues are rechecked outside public storage. Notices are local requests for host delivery, not proof of a delivered notification. No external message is sent by the adapter and no case or active rule is automatically changed.

Exact selected receipts, actor/tenant/run/public source and implementation hashes, signed current mutation tickets, private draft CAS, explicit same-question/source choice and durable intent/idempotency receipts govern authoring. Context/source reads require a current open mandate; stale, foreign or cancelled requests fail. Stage requires a prior complete method-context read and actual declared model provenance; unchanged public preflight checks exact whole schema/reference/cost population on a readonly producer route. Private adoption compares the entire selected stage and current typed fields, requiring renewed replacement consent when fields exist. Public execution is a separate exact confirmed operation; real calculation keeps the unchanged current-source/rules/certificate/scope-mandate gates. Open/uncertain mandates and incomplete intents block public operations or Archive closure as implemented. Read receipts retain exact returned bytes without claiming provider telemetry or host binary reading.
